G59a (amendment, D3a-55, after reading packet 0000 and before any propose line was ruled; applies to every propose line, none ruled before it): a proposal is held, and rejected, only where an element's statement or range or an arrow states it; a dimension's predicate or a third-order theme that only names the act places it in the ladder but does not make it an element, so where several rooms propose such an act it is a candidate and that node gives its tier. D3a-54's dimension-link rulings stand, since they asked whether a dependence is stated anywhere.
